analysis: Reviewed three changes. (1) console-ui/src/components/payouts/GlobalWithdrawModal.test.tsx: a Vitest file using synthetic fixtures (fixture-account, fixture-stripe-account, fake bank last4 1234, a 2099 expiry). It checks UI states for international bank withdrawal: estimate labels, local-currency limits, expired-quote refresh, pending-confirmation behavior, and posted-status copy. It has no production code path, secrets, or network access. (2) docs/developer/test.md: patch hunks at lines 1 and 3265 only. It bumps the last-updated date and adds a paragraph on a loopback-only dashboard HTTP regression test (useFleetData.http.test.tsx) with synthetic fleet data and a test-fixture authentication; no coordinator or real account is contacted. (3) The base_text excerpts of the same file (lines 1-867, 439+) were examined as context; they are existing docs and unchanged. No security-relevant behavior changes. I found no regressions for TB-001, TB-004 or TB-008, and no new attack surface or invalidated threat-model assumptions. The bank-withdrawal tests mention a 'Bank deposit limits' display and 'Estimated bank deposit' labels, which may relate to payout-rail features from T-055/T-060. Source for those features was not supplied, so this pass could not cover them. Coverage limit: the matching production components (StripePayoutsCard, WithdrawalsList, payout-copy, useFleetData) and the new HTTP test file are not in this batch. The next pass should check any production payout changes elsewhere in the PR for quote-expiry, idempotency and balance-check enforcement.
